skills.detail: Reduces damage received from enemies and unleashes a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect while the skill button is held down. Unleashes a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released. Additional damage is dealt to enemies based on the amount of damage reduced while the skill is active. However, any damage reduced by Trait effects will not be added. Attack partially ignores obstacles. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
